catalysts.headline: AstraZeneca completes its previously announced $2 billion equity investment in Summit Therapeutics
catalysts.impact: AstraZeneca purchased approx. 108,955 shares of convertible preferred stock, each convertible into 1,000 Summit common shares (i.e., an as-converted basis of ~108.955M common shares)

catalysts.headline: AstraZeneca announced a $2B strategic equity investment via convertible preferred shares (~109,000 shares, each convertible into 1,000 common shares; implied ~$18.35/common-share-equivalent, ~10% premium to recent trading) plus a clinical collaboration on ivonescimab and sonesitatug vedotin, and evaluation of ivonescimab alongside additional AstraZeneca ADCs; announced with updated positive Phase III HARMONi/HARMONi-2 overall-survival data
catalysts.impact: stock +17% after-hours on 9/28 announcement; +19.38% to +21.12% (sources vary) on 9/29

catalysts.headline: AstraZeneca agrees to make a $2.0 billion strategic equity investment in Summit Therapeutics via convertible preferred shares (implied common price $18.36/share), alongside a clinical trial collaboration testing ivonescimab with AstraZeneca's ADC sonesitatug vedotin in several GI cancers, with plans to test ivonescimab with other AstraZeneca ADCs/cancer medicines
catalysts.impact: Secondary trade press reports the resulting stake at roughly 12.0% of outstanding common stock (10.6% fully diluted); Summit agreed to register resale of the underlying common shares with the SEC

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: GAAP net loss $215.7M, EPS -$0.28/-$0.37 (see conflicts); cash position rose to $690.7M including ~$231M raised via ATM facility during the quarter

conflicts: Q3 2026 earnings status is unclear: several aggregators list estimated report dates in the Oct 14-22, 2026 window (all now in the past as of this 2026-10-23 pass), but no actual results coverage was found. This needs direct confirmation from Summit's investor relations page or an SEC 8-K.
pendingFilings: FDA PDUFA goal action date of 2026-11-14 for the ivonescimab BLA (ivonescimab + chemotherapy in EGFR-mutated, locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC post-TKI therapy); BLA accepted by FDA 2026-01-29
notes: Most material open item: this session could not confirm whether Summit has reported Q3 2026 results, despite several now-past estimated dates in circulation (Oct 14/19/20/22). Separately, the FDA's PDUFA goal date for the ivonescimab BLA (EGFRm NSCLC, post-TKI) is 2026-11-14, roughly three weeks from this report date -- a significant near-term regulatory catalyst to watch. No update to market cap/shares-outstanding conflicts already on file (cluster of ~744M-797M shares, ~$10.7B-$13B cap, none dated with confidence).
